description: GGPPSS five-loop master p-integrals (arXiv:2104.08272) and the map of every residual terminal the current 5L packages emit, keyed by the PACKAGE: node = family name of the owner presentation (e.g. T002e, p_node_..., P4L_J2), key = powers in its slots. Rows from the v2 map (GGPPSS) or the 1-4 library basis layer (Forcer masters, PMaster), matched by labelled graph isomorphism (Symanzik U, F and line powers); built by SCRATCHPAD/vk5l-mastermap/tools/build_v3.py, provenance in ggppss_catalogue.v3.provenance.json.
